integrity: Proof is self-contained for the claim; finite verifier corroborates but does not prove general cases. No independent validation or historical uniqueness certificate.
scientific_limitations: Square-one elements only, characteristic two, conjugacy inside the three-block unipotent group. Basic orbit mechanism appears in Diaconis–Thiem (2006); the new claim is the conditional exact rank-pair class-size enumerator and threshold. Publication priority remains subject to independent confirmation.
title: Square-one conjugacy-class spectra in three-block unipotent radicals over even fields
